issues.body: The opening attribution says `design record by Claude Opus 5`. Reviewer/author provenance is required to be model-agnostic: the stable identity is `> 🤖 SPARQ agent`, while the harness supplies the actual model. Embedding a model marker in a durable design record can become false when content is regenerated or transported and creates a second, manually maintained provenance source.
issues.fix_hint: Replace the opening attribution with the model-agnostic `> 🤖 SPARQ agent` identity (retaining the date and document purpose if desired) and remove the hard-coded model name.
issues.title: Provenance hard-codes a model identity

verdict.summary: The design recommendation is coherent and its central trust-plane claims are supported by the current tree: a clean cross-provider approval arms before the round-budget branch, injection and self-attestation remain human stops, and configured trust-surface paths extend the built-in floor. However, the document's provenance line violates the required model-agnostic SPARQ identity rule by hard-coding a model name. Because provenance is part of this repository's trust discipline, this must be corrected before approval.
